entries.title: A crewmate's request stays beside its browser while you help
entries.body: When a crewmate asks you to take over its browser, its card now stays open beside the page, with its steps, its conversation and a place to write. Ask it a question while you work, and anything you leave in the field goes to the crewmate when you return control.

picture.alt: A crewmate's browser page with its request card docked in a column on the right, the card's words above its conversation and reply field
